notes.title: Dumbinos, radial menus and saves
notes.notes:
And hello everyone, Etienne here for the latest news from Dumbino! Despite the summer period, we have plenty of new features to present to you, so fasten your seatbelts, grab your popcorn, and let's go for this new Devlog 🍿
[h2]Dumbinos, FINALLY![/h2]
They’re cute, they’re cheerful, they don’t seem very smart… The [b]Dumbinos [/b]are finally joining the scene! Equipped with special abilities and determined to use any means necessary to make their peers fall, these surprising dominoes come to offer a whole arsenal of possibilities to overcome the levels. Hit, explode, suck, jump… this new dose of fantasy will join the new demo very soon!
[img]https://sweetdreams.studio/img/blog/2024-08-30-devlog-4/image1.gif[/img]
[h2]A free hand[/h2]
As the new Dumbino content arrives with the appearance of the next world, our magic hand is also evolving to offer you greater freedom of action. Thus, your next games will allow you to discover our brand new radial menu, which will allow you to make all the objects of your choice (or almost) appear on the game table, to imagine solutions, each crazier than the last! Come on, it's still a prototype, but we're sure you'll know how to make good use of it 🎉
[img]https://sweetdreams.studio/img/blog/2024-08-30-devlog-4/image2.gif[/img]
[h2]Level editor (again?!)[/h2]
Yes, there is no stopping it, the level editor continues its evolution to offer you a finer manipulation of values ​​thanks to the inspector, but also a system for saving and loading your levels. Sharing your masterpieces is now as simple as sending a file: we can't wait to see what you'll do with them!
[img]https://sweetdreams.studio/img/blog/2024-08-30-devlog-4/image3.gif[/img]
[h2]What next?[/h2]
September is going to be a month of significant growth for Dumbino. In addition to the various tweaks we're going to make to the game to make it even more enjoyable to use, it's also and above all the right time to add as much content as possible to the game! New levels, new worlds, new mechanics, new bugs... Ah, I'm being told in my earpiece that this last point wasn't necessary. Stay alert, Dumbino is about to reveal its true colors!
Well then, it's time to conclude this devlog and wish good luck to all of you who are going back to school or work. By the way, this could be an opportunity for you to check out the "games are going back to school!" event on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/sale/backtoschoolsale2024.
If you want to support Dumbino and help us, don't hesitate to add the game to your wishlist on Steam, and spread the word! Every addition counts! 💕
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3069140/Dumbino/
Bye!! 👋

notes.title: Devlog : Demo, Community et Development
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, it's Argann, and a lot has happened since the last time! Demo release, community updates, game development progress, new trailer... It looks like we have a lot to talk about! 🤔 Put on your best floral shirt, stay zen, and let's dive in!

[h1]Demo Recap[/h1]

Last week, we released the first official demo version of Dumbino! It was a bit stressful and a lot of work, but we're super proud of it. Several streamers even played it, and we finally got to see you wrack your brains and have fun with the levels carefully designed by François. It really warmed our hearts, especially since you seemed to really enjoy the game! So, a big thank you to:

[list][*][url=https://www.twitch.tv/haripear]Haripear[/url]
[/*][*][url=https://www.twitch.tv/solivann]Solivann[/url]
[/*][*][url=https://www.twitch.tv/bytell2]Bytell[/url]
[/*][*][url=https://www.twitch.tv/seldell]Seldell[/url]
[/*][*][url=https://www.twitch.tv/mllepeps]MllePeps[/url]
[/*][*][url=https://www.twitch.tv/maevys]Maevys[/url]
[/*][*][url=https://www.twitch.tv/billiechou]Billiechou[/url]
[/*][/list]
Be sure to check them out! Overall, the demo's reception has been very positive, but still a bit timid. If you want to help us out, add the game to your Steam wishlist! It would greatly help us get a bit more visibility on Steam. And of course, the demo is still available for free download!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3069140/Dumbino/

[h1]Level Editor[/h1]

Previously, we've talked a lot about the "level editor" we're developing. You might think that with the demo release, not much progress has been made... 

Well, it's quite the opposite: it's progressing super fast! 

Thanks to our hard work, especially by Étienne, we now have a first version of the editor with all the basic interactions we wanted. Let's take a little tour! 

At the bottom of the screen, you'll find the library, which groups all the game objects into different categories.

[img]https://lh7-us.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXeufVIVqyokV9S1_DFOLt4C7uYkkPJ5ZvMg-vYd1qgoRgqjsz7RqcBKu8ybgAxEYq1ckjsg4aYCQmC4s3UJGfucikgICtyadPDHI1eZTnP4PcVspjU65xk0se9WyQ0_KLG4XNv81R6l0MgjoQz8lv1FUpU?key=TeJxpBXcVKOY8l6DRxsXQA[/img]

With a single click, you can easily place dominos, goals, and even multiple starting points!

Manipulating already placed objects is also very easy! You can select one or multiple objects, move them, rotate them, resize them, or even duplicate them with a snap of your fingers. 

[img]https://lh7-us.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXdQhfzdE3tWRN-kZSY0SdeYX6igUbPY0NjDlzuptyqv5ZZvB_U94p8ZP0jNCowvjdSv74fDIkOmjFoXwbG1hSW0HBohrSMy6LDudF_BaalqFT3kvtVZwA6CySMLousF-AhVXEFETmflYBgQ3KYPxMZqJypB?key=TeJxpBXcVKOY8l6DRxsXQA[/img]

Making complex levels becomes child's play!

And of course, all these actions can be undone if needed, so don’t be afraid to experiment!

[h1]Next Steps[/h1]

While some will be taking well-deserved vacations, we'll use the coming weeks to continue improving Dumbino! 

For the level editor, François will revisit each screen to make everything look a bit nicer, and we'll try to polish all existing interactions. 

My goal will be to connect everything to the level system I've already developed so that created levels can be saved, loaded, and played. 

And for the "official" levels, you can bet we still have a lot of surprises in store for you!


And that's the end of this devlog! I hope you enjoyed it! 

If you want to support Dumbino and help us out, [b]add the game to your Steam wishlist and spread the word![/b] Every action counts! 💕 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3069140/Dumbino/

With that, I wish you a great week, and see you next time!

notes.title: Devlog : launch of Dumbino !
notes.notes:
[h1]Making our Sandbox & Physics Puzzle Game![/h1]
Hello everyone!

This is the Sweet Dreams Studio team, François, Argann, and Etienne! We're a bunch of French indie devs, and today we have a fair share of exciting news to share with you! We've just reached a big milestone by launching our Steam page, thanks to all the feedback from our community that helped us make the logo and the key art. Now that our Steam page is up, we have a demo live that you can try right now! We've been hard at work to make it with all the additions and improvements that you suggested during the playtests we held.

Try our demo now!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3069140/Dumbino/

Enjoyed it? Then add Dumbino to your wishlist, it's the best way to support us!


Because a lot of things happened under the hood before the Steam page, here's a recap of our latest adventures and upcoming features!

[h2]Chapter 1: Launch of Itch.io Page and Playtest 0.2.0-alpha[/h2]

In our first devblog, we announced the opening of our Itch.io page for Dumbino. This has allowed us to share game versions more easily without the hassle of worrying about expired links. We also launched the playtest of version 0.2.0-alpha, available for free on Windows. This playtest helped us gather valuable feedback thanks to your participation and comments through our feedback form. Thank you to everyone who took the time to test and share your impressions!

[h2]Chapter 2: Progress on the Level Editor and Artistic Direction[/h2]

We've been burning the midnight oil on the level editor, a very important feature to us that will let you create your own unique puzzles and constructions to challenge others! Although it is still in development, we can't wait to show you more!

On the art direction side, François, our "Supreme Artistic Director" (yes, it's a real title), shared the first illustrations of Dumbino. Many of you participated in the survey and chose your favorite illustration. Thank you for your valuable input; we took all precious suggestions and ideas into account to refine the visual identity of our game.

[h2]Chapter 3: Demo Preparation and Tutorial[/h2]

We paused the development of the level editor to focus on a game demo scheduled for the end of June. We've been adding new content, integrating, and testing various features to make sure that you get to play the best domino-based demo ever!

Another crucial addition is the comprehensive tutorial, designed by Etienne, to help new players easily understand the controls and game mechanics in just two minutes. We hope this will make your experience with the game even smoother. Any feedback on the tutorial is greatly appreciated!

[h2]Chapter 4: Finalizing the Key Art and Diverse Levels[/h2]

The key art for Dumbino has been finalized thanks to your input, with a yellow background that was favored. We've made good progress quickly in creating new levels and game mechanics. Our goal is to offer a variety of levels, including complex puzzles, absurd levels, and also creative ones! A bit of chaos is always a nice addition to strategy!

We're also working on the decorations to create an immersive child's room atmosphere, with details like comics, marbles, drawings, and crayons. Every detail counts to create this cozy and vivid setting.

[h2]The end of one chapter and the continuation of this adventure![/h2]

We plan to organize more playtests in the future to keep improving Dumbino with your feedback and suggestions. The demo is available with the launch of our Steam page, and that's already a way to let us know your thoughts on the latest playable version of the game! We're incredibly excited about this new step and look forward to gathering even more input to make Dumbino the best game possible.

We're extremely delighted to see the reception of Dumbino once we started showing the game to more people. Our community is growing and we've been receiving genuine and constructive feedback that was critical in our progress. Every comment and suggestion helps us refine Dumbino and make it even more enjoyable to play. We have put all our hearts into this project, and your encouragement motivates us to keep moving forward. Thank you for your support, and see you soon for more adventures with us and the development of Dumbino!

Don't forget to follow us on Steam and participate in future playtests. We can't wait to read more of your comments and share this passion project with all of you.

Join our Discord server to chat with us and get information on Dumbino firsthand!

See you soon,

The Dumbino Team
